description:
Kang Jae-Hui is constantly haunted by the mistakes of his past, mistakes he can neither forget nor abandon. One day, while living a monotonous life as if punishing himself, he is assigned to produce a corporate newsletter project. He is tasked with interviewing Cha Hak-Yun, a reporter for the NSB News Department's Social Affairs Bureau and one of the most talked-about figures of the moment. On the day of the hard-won interview, a series of unpredictable incidents unfolded, from being late to a sudden motorcycle collision. Despite his initially cold and businesslike demeanor, Cha Hak-Yun carefully looked after him, helping him get through the interview safely. But his gratitude was short-lived; he found himself flustered by his persistent follow-up contact...

*“I'm not doing it. Dating.”

“Who's going to eat you? Why are you so scared? I'm just saying, let's date a little.”*

What should have been a fleeting coincidence had somehow transformed into an inexplicable destiny.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
